goal: Guaranteed classical deterministic N^(1/6) semiprime factorization, proved in Lean
research_instruction: Check these inherited positive targets before claiming a fresh constructor. A supplied-data consumer, equivalence, or cheap restricted family is not whole-family acquisition.

inherited_targets.name: Sparse Frobenius prefix and isolated binomial factor sum
inherited_targets.input: N=PQ with odd primes P<Q<2P, M=floor(sqrt(2N))
inherited_targets.identity: (1+X)^N = 1+Q X^P+P X^Q modulo (N,X^(M+1)); P+Q = 1-(-1)^M binom(N-1,M) modulo N
inherited_targets.missing: Cheap truncation or isolated coefficient acquisition; scalar evaluation includes the tail

inherited_targets.name: Factorial first jet
inherited_targets.identity: For F_M(X)=product_(1<=i<=M)(X+i), B=M!, b=B/N unit, F'_M(0)=b(P+Q) modulo N
inherited_targets.missing: Acquiring B modulo N^2 and derivative cheaply; constant-state product recurrence is not a cheap long jump

inherited_targets.name: Smooth projection and shared roots
inherited_targets.input: Explicit exponent E=(m!)^A with A=O(log N)
inherited_targets.paid: Smooth-part projection, factor recovery on projected collapse, outside-product roots for small j^2
inherited_targets.missing: A constructor covering remaining large rough local orders; repeating smooth-order cases is not new

inherited_targets.name: Shared selected q-binomial coefficients and jets
inherited_targets.paid: nu selected indices from one common length-L coefficient stream in soft O(sqrt L+nu); polylogarithmic parameter jets are similarly paid
inherited_targets.missing: Reduction of native changing-target row sums or sufficient norm to those selected data

inherited_targets.name: Original quadratic row product
inherited_targets.paid: Forced collision over all rows; generic shared evaluator soft O(J+sqrt(JL))
inherited_targets.missing: Whole-family restriction-stable soft O(m) evaluator or sufficient factor query

inherited_targets.name: Sparse factor-residue Gauss consumer
inherited_targets.paid: Supplied explicit J-residue menu modulo n covering one factor gives soft O(N^(1/6)+J+N^(1/5)(J/n)^(3/5))
inherited_targets.sufficient_data: P+Q modulo r, r~N^(1/18), creates r lift classes modulo r^2
inherited_targets.missing: Acquiring that trace, or another sufficiently sparse guaranteed factor menu, in soft O(r^3)

inherited_targets.name: QRH long-annihilator decoder
inherited_targets.paid: Given prepared gamma with odd local orders >16m^2 and nonzero L-bit K annihilating gamma, factor in soft O(L+N^(1/12)), accepting pinned uniform Dirichlet QRH input
inherited_targets.missing: Acquiring K within soft O(m); also not a new Lean proof of the analytic input

inherited_targets.name: Compact GAP group-order cover consumer
inherited_targets.paid: Descriptions of polylog rank, actual volumes and descriptor bits soft m, separated hulls, individual crossdifference divisible by one local order imply soft-m factor recovery without prefactoring
inherited_targets.missing: Uniform explicit construction with the stated individual-difference cover

inherited_targets.name: Explicit Lehman-start acquisition family
inherited_targets.identity: c_uv=uN+v-ceil(2sqrt(uvN)), uv<=m^2; one c_uv-i is a positive local-order multiple for 0<=i<m
inherited_targets.missing: Actual giant volume is soft m^2; a faster restricted-product evaluator remains unproved

inherited_targets.name: Paired critical norm and carry-preserving stationary transform
inherited_targets.paid: Exact additive stationary-phase convolution and O(m) reflection-boundary normalization
inherited_targets.missing: Multiplicative long norm evaluator; the quadratic transfer recurrence is standard, and cross-a bulk cancellation reintroduces the same critical product
